name: readtext-starting-at-for
script: readtext POSIX file "$FILES/utf8.txt" starting at 6 for 2

name: readtext-for-past-end
script: readtext POSIX file "$FILES/utf8.txt" starting at 15 for 1000

name: readtext-redirect-timeout
script: readtext POSIX file "$FILES/utf8.txt" redirect false timeout 5

name: writetext-basic
script:
writetext "Café 😀" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-basic.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-basic.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-append
script:
writetext "one" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-append.txt"
writetext "two" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-append.txt" with append
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-append.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-append-new-file
script:
writetext "two" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-append-new.txt" with append
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-append-new.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-overwrite-truncates
script:
writetext "a long line" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-trunc.txt"
writetext "x" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-trunc.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-trunc.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-utf16
script:
writetext "é" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-utf16.txt" encoding "UTF-16"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-utf16.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-utf16le
script:
writetext "é" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-utf16le.txt" encoding "UTF-16LE"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-utf16le.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-macroman
script:
writetext "Café" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-mac.txt" encoding "MACINTOSH"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-mac.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-missing-char
script:
writetext "a😀bé" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-missing.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1" missing char "?"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-missing.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-number
script:
writetext 12 to POSIX file "$TMP/w-number.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-number.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-crlf
script:
writetext ("a" & return & linefeed & "b") to POSIX file "$TMP/w-crlf.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-crlf.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"

name: writetext-roundtrip-default
script:
writetext "Café 😀" to POSIX file "$TMP/w-round.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/w-round.txt"

name: find-file-all
script: find text "alpha" in POSIX file "$FILES/search.txt" with all occurrences

name: find-file-after-multibyte
script: find text "alpha" in POSIX file "$FILES/search.txt" starting at 25

name: find-file-regexp
script: find text "g(a+)mma" in POSIX file "$FILES/search.txt" with regexp

name: find-file-regexp-using
script: find text "é (\\w+)" in POSIX file "$FILES/search.txt" using "\\1" with regexp and string result

name: find-file-string-result-all
script: find text "a[a-z]+" in POSIX file "$FILES/search.txt" with regexp, all occurrences and string result

name: change-file-literal
script:
writetext ("alpha beta" & linefeed & "gamma alpha" & linefeed & "é alpha" & linefeed) to POSIX file "$TMP/c1.txt"
change "alpha" into "ALPHA" in POSIX file "$TMP/c1.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c1.txt"

name: change-file-regexp
script:
writetext ("alpha beta" & linefeed & "gamma alpha" & linefeed & "é alpha" & linefeed) to POSIX file "$TMP/c2.txt"
change "(\\w+) (alpha)" into "\\2 \\1" in POSIX file "$TMP/c2.txt" with regexp
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c2.txt"

name: change-file-no-match
script:
writetext ("alpha beta" & linefeed & "gamma alpha" & linefeed & "é alpha" & linefeed) to POSIX file "$TMP/c3.txt"
change "zzz" into "y" in POSIX file "$TMP/c3.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c3.txt"

name: change-file-list
script:
writetext ("alpha beta" & linefeed & "gamma alpha" & linefeed & "é alpha" & linefeed) to POSIX file "$TMP/c4.txt"
change {"alpha", "beta"} into {"1", "2"} in POSIX file "$TMP/c4.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c4.txt"

name: change-file-multibyte
script:
writetext ("alpha beta" & linefeed & "gamma alpha" & linefeed & "é alpha" & linefeed) to POSIX file "$TMP/c5.txt"
change "é" into "e" in POSIX file "$TMP/c5.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c5.txt"

name: change-file-utf16
script:
writetext "é é" to POSIX file "$TMP/c6.txt" encoding "UTF-16"
change "é" into "x" in POSIX file "$TMP/c6.txt"
readtext POSIX file "$TMP/c6.txt" encoding "ISO-8859-1"
